preconditions.description: The length of s_1 is between 1 and 100.
The length of s_2 is between 1 and 100.
The length of virus is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in s_1)
preconditions.description: All characters in s_1 are uppercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in s_2)
preconditions.description: All characters in s_2 are uppercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in virus)
preconditions.description: All characters in virus are uppercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The length of the output is non-negative.
The output does not contain virus as a substring.
The output is a subsequence of both s_1 and s_2.

postconditions.expression: not any(is_subsequence(other_output, s_1) and is_subsequence(other_output, s_2) and other_output != output and virus not in other_output for other_output in possible_outputs)
postconditions.description: The output is the longest possible common subsequence that does not contain virus as a substring.
